      <h1 class="about-hero-title">
        Bridging the gap between <em>complex systems</em> and <em>intelligent reasoning</em>.
      </h1>
      
      <section class="about-body">
        <p><b>Hello, I'm Hygor!</b></p>
        
        <p>I am a Data Scientist working as a consultant in projects for different areas like retail, supply chain, and optimization. I leverage mathematics, engineering, and deep analysis to turn raw data into clean, production-grade solutions.</p>
        
        <p>I have more than seven years of experience as a Systems Architect, Analyst, and Software Engineer in the development of web-based and mobile applications. This background allows me to build ML systems that are not just models in a sandbox, but robust architectures designed to integrate smoothly with enterprise software environments.</p>
        
        <p>In my Master's research, I worked within the Machine Learning area, focused on computational intelligence and the development of semi-supervised learning algorithms—seeking elegant ways to train models when labeled data is scarce.</p>
        
        <p>My core interest is in working on high-impact solutions that employ data, artificial intelligence, and machine learning methods to build new, highly-scalable, and transparent capabilities for users.</p>
      </section>
